text: Wow! This place is the bomb! After reading the reviews, we decided to check this place out. And it did not disappoint. We came as a group of 7 and everyone tried something different. The meats are all delicious. I ordered the green Chile pork. So good. The carne asada was full of flavor. Delicious rice and beans. And the portions are big. If I lived in Tucson I'd be coming here all the time.
The food was amazing! Favorite dish is kare Kare and loved the halo halo. Will definitely be back many times. Loved chef chrispin's stories, too.

You can always rely on Mel's for good food at a decent price.  No different on this visit.  yes, we all had to mask and the tables are 6 feet apart, but everything else is the same.  We ate there twice  - once late night and once mid morning, and had great servers both times.  We ordered from the breakfast menu both times with french toast, pancakes, various egg preparations, and sides, and all our food came out perfectly!  Thank you, Mel's @ Boomtown - we'll be back!

My usual spot when I go to NOLA. I love, love, love this place! Their food is always fresh and the SAME every time I go which is a plus for me because I always know that my food is going to come out hot and great! We sat at the bar during this quick lunch visit and course the free warm red potatoes with butter was my first request before I ordered my drink (forget to ask to ask for them!). Strongly suggest everyone stops there for lunch or dinner

Their sweet corn chicken tamales... that's it. That's the post. It is SO GOOD! It's a creamy but flavorful. I was able to get a half dozen tamales through Market Wagon and honestly it will become a frequent purchase. I first learned about 3 in 1 when I saw them at Yelp's Bazaar in December. I remember their booth was empty and I wanted to support a local Latino business. Best decision I made. They were so sweet and so good! I could've gotten more. I certainly will continue to support this business now that I recently live closer to them!
Every time we go through Nashville we have to stop here for breakfast. Lines are always out the door, food is always fresh and soo darn good. Lovely location near Vanderbilt. Always a family win.

I stumbled across this place just on a brief scroll of Instagram. I'm a huge fan of Mexican and this place definitely delivered for me. Literally 2 days in a row I went and each time was delighful. My waitress Hailey was awesome super welcoming from the start to finish.

Food Menu:
* The menu was a smaller menu than normal since covid19. Though limited I still was able to find some good items. I selected the taco trio chicken, pork, and steak all were delicious. They have a delicious sweet corn dish which was good. 

Drink Menu: 
* Tequila, Tequila, tequila lol thats all I wanted. I enjoyed 2 house margaritas with a added on flavor for an additional dollar. The drinks were really good and can be purchased in a variety of sizes. I'm sure its other items offered but my eyes went straight for the gold.

Covid Regulations:
Indoor and outdoor seating is offered.
Inside the seating took a while wait was said to be over 1 hr and 15 mins but only took 20 mintues. Outside is first come first served. The seats are separated keeping the 6ft guidelines in mind. The staff (my hostess) wore a mask which made me super happy.

Decor:
Decor in this place is super cute. Very artistic like. Beautiful color pops everywhere. A super famous lime green payphone with a super catchy and social media worthy quote. The bar had beautiful graffiti like paintings inside along with the main dining area wall as well.

Price range $3-$20 Per items. Cost Efficient

Tex Mex barbecue in Indianapolis, sign me up. 


Visited this restaurant this evening, the service, food and environment were all top notch. The restaurant has only been open for a month but is ran as if it has gear of experience. The carnitas nachos were the perfect blend of savory and spicy and creamy. I highly recommend to split among a few people as a starter. I was also able to try the frito loco sandwich and I am dying over it, smoked meat, cheese, jalapeños, Fritos and bbq sauce...there is nothing better especially when paired with their fries. There fries are top notch and are salted perfectly. I cannot wait to return soon as their business grows.

Pretty solid takeout! I was looking for a new Black owned restaurant and hadn't tried here so it was a quarantine treat. 
I had the country fried chicken plate. Love that it was boneless! Nice amount of breading and well seasoned. It maintained a decent amount of crunch even despite the travel time. It came with collard greens and mashed sweet potatoes that were quite good too. I'll admit the chips were a bit too salty/spicy for my taste. 
The cornbread with strawberry butter was so good!! Would certainly check this place out again.

We are in town visiting Washington University with my daughter.  We decided to check out the foodie scene in St Louis.  We found Kounter Kulture via Yelp reviews.  We couldn't believe a small little restaurant like this with no indoor seating could produce such great food.  The food indeed was great.  I was creative Asian fusion like creations placed in a takeout container...brilliant!

The staff was so helpful they even gave me a list of other local area restaurants to try out for breakfast and lunch.  Knead bread company was great...thanks for the recommendation!  Quality staff and quality food!  Must try if you are in St. Louis!

Food was correct, but service was horrible. I work  in the food industry and we would never do what happened to me. I went the other day with my girlfriend her step brother and some family friends kids, I went to the counter to get some extra sauce and a cup of water and the manager looked right at me twice as well as multiple employees for 3 plus minutes before an employee noticed me and asked what I needed. I probably will not be going back to this McDonald's for a while. I definitely would not suggest this location.
I had the husky house special with salmon and chicken and it was amazing. Fresh moist and flavorful. Completely different than any other pizza place I've been too

They RIPPED US OFF is my opening statement. I have visit this restaurant on many times and have always been pleased with the food and service. I am writing this compliant about the meal we purchase on mother's day May 10, 2020.  We order family size salmon with lobster bisque, lobster man n cheese, aspasgas , and dessert. The salmon was suppose to be whole fillet and this is what we got .

We were in the mood for some shrimp, so we were hoping this place would hit the spot but were pretty disappointed. There was a hair in my salad (which they did replace but I kind of lost my appetite after that) , shrimp was meh, and our appetizer tasted like it was from Walmart's frozen isle. My man's food was ok but we expected more from a place that has shrimp in a title. Maybe it was just an off day for them but i don't think I'd be back to try them again.

Twice in a row, many days apart, our lunch group of 4 have gotten here at 11:30 and they have had no ribs. That is the reason at least two of us come. Their brisket is great but we don't want brisket or pulled pork. Very disappointing. BTW, their sweet potato fries are fantastic, at least some consolation.

Business was slow and the service was even slower.I had been planning on stopping at this establishment for quite some time.I should have skipped it.Sat at the bar and it took an inordinate amount of time to be served a drink.On top of that,the staff gravitated toward people/ regulars that they recognized and served them first.I was merely an afterthought.It even took quite a long time to simply pay my bill.Based on this,it is highly unlikely that I shall ever return
I recently dined at this establishment; I have to say.... overall it was a pleasant experience. The food was tasty, service was friendly.... just needs a facelift.

Good pizza is hard to find, but I found some at Cappy's. Their stuffed pizza is awesome. It's filled with toppings and cheese, and is the perfect comfort food. The pizzeria is cozy with an energetic atmosphere. The staff is friendly and welcoming. Cappy's Pizzeria is a great place to hang out with friends, or to have a romantic date at.

Love this place!  Best coffee spot in the area by a mile and the food is some of the best food you can get around here too.  I don't eat alot of baked goods but omg the baked goods here are amazing.  Really great soups too.  Don't forget to ask about the soup!

You may not notice " Cafe Conti "on the outside but if you see it definitely you should stop and try it. They offer a wide range of french food and I got the " Nutella Banana Crepe " which was just amazing. It was really really good and was done to perfection. To drink I got the " Cafe Latte " and it was the best latte I have ever had. It even had a design on it! It was perfectly done too. I have never been to a better cafe in my life and i've been to some really famous ones in Paris. Another thing is you feel like your in France when your in " Cafe Conti "! I really recommend this restaurant in every way.

We are sitting enjoying our food and a man named Steve.. looks like a manager is being completely rude to employees in front of guests and LOUD about it. He seems to be on break
And eating and demanding the employees take food back and fix it and says they are  incompetent... while they have a smile on their face I may add. He also stated very loudly across the store "I don't care if I work here or not. I expect it to be right." Very disrespectful. Very surprised to see someone like that works here.. not the chick fil a way.

One of those places that you wish was open for dinner.  Great food at a great price.  Awesome employees that are friendly and helpful.

If you like fried seafood, the fried shrimp and oysters are some of the best in the season.  Lightly batter and fresh.

The roast beef poboys and fish tacos are some of my favorites.

There is a wide variety of seafood dishes and poboys.

Give this place a try.  You won't be disappointed.

Great location for the Grand Prix. 

My table was on the sidewalk, the umbrella provided enough shade. 

Grant was a very attentive waiter. 

Tortilla espanola was not up to par. I havent had a good one there in a while. However the aoli sauce it is seved with is very good. I would have preferred more potatoes in it. 

The sangria was amazing as always full of apples and oranges. Delicious.

Nice decor but we've seen that. Sat at bar even thought had a reservation. I didn't want to make my one self occupy a table. The restaurant did have a table for me. Cocktails are good, but priced high. Good service at a crowded bar with some strange bed fellows and wanna-be celebs. Food for what they are charging is nothing special and again we pay for over head and to be seen by the paparazzi- but why?!?

Not impressed with the food, food was very bland. Ordered a Mojara frita and it was over fried, the rice looked watery. The waitress offered me something else but I declined as I lost my appetite. For sure not coming back.
Liam Pollenz was so nice and was always checking up on me to see if my meal was going well. Enjoyed him being there.

A good friend had recommended a Peruvian place after I shared a story of having some on a recent trip to NYC. She mentioned El Balconcito II, in Northeast Philadelphia. She also said that they have the best Lomo Saltado she's had in Philly. 

We made plans to meet up and have lunch there (Thursday, Jan 16th), and I was happy I waited to go with her. Upon entering the restaurant, you will see a clean, well maintained establishment. The aroma of whatever was cooking in the kitchen when we walked in was heavenly!  It was during lunch time, yet there were plenty of places to sit. We took a booth, and looked at the menu. 

My friend, being fluent in Spanish, took care of ordering. I only know a few things in Spanish, and I used what I knew when it was necessary. The waiter was attentive and friendly, and answered any questions I had. My friend suggested Intry a drink they called "chicha morada", which is a purple corn beverage. I had never heard of it, and was skeptical about what could possibly taste like. But she said that I was going to like it. She was right. I did. The first food to arrive was the Ceviche. I had never had it before, and once my friend explained what it was, I wanted to try it. 

Then the main dishes came out. She had a steak and shrimp entree, and I had the Lomo Saltado. This is the dish I had in a little corner restaurant in NYC. It was really good, but THIS one is way better. 

So, just as a heads-up, your experience may be better if you speak Spanish, or g

DONT SLEEP ON THIS PLACE! Good sushi in the West Bank which is def hard to find. We didn't have high expectations but they definitely were exceeded! Also, the place is cute! Something I'd expect that would be in downtown.

Ordered: salmon toro (5/5), hamachi jalapeño (4/5), clear soup (5/5) (I've tried bad clear soup before), agedashi tofu (4/5), thanksgiving roll (4/5), & sexiest man roll (5/5)

This place is awesome. I've been a few times and tried a bunch of different things. The carne Asada is great, as are the chalupas. I've never had anything that wasn't excellent. The sauces are so good, the service is great and everyone who works there is friendly.

Had a large chicken salad .it was excellent .as other poster previously mentioned why dont they cut in half as its pretty hefty .
Also i wanted only a sandwich 
.i wasnt real clear and counter lady didnt ask so spent double what i wanted .my fault not being extra specific .
Quality does match price point .
And a lot home made salads and lunch meat too .
No hot options were available .
Not sure if that's just today or permanent ?
For this time of year a couple hot options and a soup would be sellers .
Overall good spot and will return and recommend.

A friend brought me here to buy me lunch. We sat outside on a nice day and my friend's dog sat with us (under the table of course). I had the club sandwich and found the food and the service to be very pleasant. I had been aware of this restaurant but just never stopped in before. I will be coming back again.
First time to Jun Dynasty. Had Kung Pao Chicken lunch special. Surprised how good it was.  Look forward to trying more dishes on next visit.

Walked in chili's about 9:50 PM when me and my lady first walked in we weren't greeted he just told us to sit anywhere so I sat in the booth next to the Tv to watch the game 20 min go by and we don't have water yet, nobody even came to greet us at our table then finally we get ahold of the same guy and he doesn't even come up to our table to talk to us he stands 3 tables away to basically have us yell out our question. We just walked out after that  terrible customer service. 

Didn't catch the chili's employee but he had a bald spot in the middle of his head and was black not to be funny but only way to describe. If I could give zero stars I would. I love chili's and this wasn't a good experience just moved out here from Chicago too PHILLY is off to a bad start.

Updating my review. Still one star. First time I went I found something in my sandwich. I decided to give them another shot. Second time I went they literally jumped on my case for taking MY receipt. Apparently they have some sort of system here where you're not allowed to have your own damn receipt. They keep them to make your order but there's no possible way you could know that  if you don't frequent this spot. Needless to say I'm done for good. Subway for me.

I'm glad to have the opportunity to enjoy lunch at this cafe today. The atmosphere was charming, casual, and tastefully decorated, with plenty of options to choose from. Everyone was friendly, and the service was excellent.  The food was fresh and delicious. I will definitely come back when in the area again. Highly recommended!

Wow wow wow! I'm totally speechless after trying Cafe Lava tonight. My first time and definitely not my last! 

Before I go into the review, let me just say how extravagant this place is. What they've done is absolutely gorgeous. The decor is uniquely breathtaking and like nothing I've seen before. Felt so fancy and upscale. 

I noticed that they have an outdoor patio behind the restaurant near the parking. I presume it's used only when the weather is warm. Looks like it has a lot of space for entertaining. I can see myself enjoying a nice little brunch out there later this year. 

The restaurant was basically empty when we arrived. It's huge in there. Looks deceivingly small from the outside though. I can only image how many customers they can fit there on weekends and how busy it probably gets. We were seated at a table by the window, which was great. A woman who looked like the manager came over and swung the curtains open to bring some natural light in. Our waitress walked up and took our drink order shortly after. Didn't get her name but she was awesome and very attentive throughout the night. She brought us bread and butter with the drinks. 

We asked for the sweet fire pancakes from the appetizer menu and my friend got the mac and cheese. The sweet fire pancakes were on point! They were small sweet potato patties fried with red peppers inside and topped with sour cream. The sour cream offset the spiciness of the pancake. My friend let me try her mac... as a cheese love

Great local spot I finally checked out due to Covid. The gentleman who came out to the parking lot to bring my food had a great personality and a smile on his face. My kids and I had a great time chatting with him, it's great to see small business' doing well.
Food was amazing. The lady at the counter gave us samples so we could decide since this was our first visit. Chicken salad was great, and the soup delicious! We will definitely be back!

Very good Torta. Didn't try the tacos this time but last time I had it was delicious. 

The are is really bad and building from the outside looks crappy, but the inside is better.

Horchata was on point.

Mexicans don't eat burritos so I will not try it since that isn't authentic so I can't say anything about that. 

I'm giving this a 4 star because the chips weren't the ones we usually eat. Salsa felt from the can (except the ones for the actual food)  and the outside look. The actual food was great.

Burrata is 10/10. I will absolutely return for another classy BYOB dinner.

EATS: I ordered the potato gnocchi and experienced delight with every bite. The gnocchi is pillowy, melts in your mouth, and is served with wild mushrooms, walnuts, pecorino, and truffle oil. The walnuts add an unexpected crunch, making the gnocchi a more dynamic dish, and the truffle oil...well, if you ask me, this ingredient can make almost any savory meal a knock-out.

AMBIANCE: Burrata is fairly small, allowing for an intimate dining experience. The service at this restaurant is superb as well. Our waiter was friendly, cracked a few jokes with our table, and gave wonderful recommendations. 

Definitely visit Burrata for a charming dining experience!

My favorite pizza in St Louis hands down. And a $9 all you can eat pizza buffet during the week is just stupid indulgent (I mean that as the most awesome compliment). You could easily do the pizza only but they have a decent salad bar and some serious sides (cannelloni bites, chicken wings, etc.). This is the OG store but St Peters is great as well. And I would be remiss without giving the servers their do. They really work hard to keep up with the volumes and do a fantastic job. Dinner and take out are wonderful as well.

There are a Few of these type places popping up over nashville. This one is one of the best.  Quick tasty. Fun simple atmosphere. Plenty of parking. Centrally located. 

They are family owned and run so bonuses.


You will enjoy this!!!

This place never disappoints! Tried the taco poutine today: fresh cut taters with beef gravy, curds, shredduce, sour cream, tomatoes, cheddar cheese and taco beef then topped with crushed cheesy nacho chips. The fries are always crispy and the poutine is nicely layered so you always get a good bite right to the end. Can wait to try another flavour next time.

5 Tuna Poke Bowl/ sushi rice, mango, avocado, fresh seaweed: Have had this dish a number of times and it always consistently delicious. The ingredients are always fresh. Even though the dish is packed with flavor you never feel overwhelmed afterwards.

Overall 5: Food is pretty consistent. They will change the menu seasonally. They offer fresh bread to start. If you have a gluten allergy they offer, gluten free crackers.  Really nice wine selection. A few of the wines from South Africa are highly recommended! Staff is always very friendly and attentive. Great views of the city.

Great Cajun food outside New Orleans. Never had a bad meal on the menu.  New Orleans is my second home and I was raised in Louisiana so I know food. Love the atmosphere and since Covid have felt safe for take out and eating in since that's been allowed. Haven't had charbroiled oysters this good beyond the coast.

We went on a Monday, and the place was dead, nonetheless I had a reservation and the staff was VERY nice. They remembered my name throughout the entire night and always addressed me, which was nice! We split the meatball appetizer, which was great. Huge wine list. I got the ravioli, which was small, but good. My pasta was a little too al dente for my liking, but had good flavor. My boyfriend got the gnocchi which he ate so fast I didn't even get to try, but he obviously enjoyed it! I think the price point is a little above the quality of the food. The atmosphere was great. Overall, this place was good but I probably won't be running back.

Update: In recent months, quality has gone down, as well as fewer options and less turnover while at the buffet. They were going strong for a while, but now all of the saucy dishes are overly sweet and not as fresh as they used to be.  Used to love this place, but I'm finding myself wanting other places nearby (or *gasp* New Jersey) instead.

On September 15, 2019, I celebrated my 9th anniversary. I went to the second floor this time,  because it contains a steakhouse. Our waitress was a metallic redhead named Nina. She served us with the same quality of service I had when I visited high end steakhouses in Washington DC. I ordered the lamb. It was so good I even ate the bones. It was perfectly seasoned,  perfectly cooked. My gorgeous date had the 1892 burger. It was also cooked to her exact specification, and was so good, I wasn't able to have a bite. The tallow tots had a distinct tallow flavor, and our appetizers (lobster rolls and onion rings) shocked us. We were not expecting them to be as good as they were. The flavor of the lobster rolls especially,  with their buttery, oceanic flavor with a hint of lemon zest recorded or palettes for what was to come. The bread they gave out was good to. To top it off, they gave us a small dessert to congratulate us. Merchants is truly a restaurant that cares about quality on all levels and certainly deserves the 5 stars.

This place was sooooo good!!  Not from the area and was looking for a place that had good burgers. My boys ordered the Turkey burger and the Double Smash and I had the Beef Brisket... wow, everything was delicious.  Then we ordered the Salted Caramel Cheesecake....AMAZING!!  This place should be a 5 star.

We were very excited to try this restaurant for restaurant week. We usually went to Morton's but unfortunately it was closed this year. We waited (table of 3) for about 10 minutes past our reservation time to be seated though we were early and the restaurant was fairly empty. When we were sat we were given bread. There was something in my napkin and when I picked it up, I realized it was a human fake fingernail from a waitress with remnants of the human nail. We were so disgusted but decided to give them another chance since the manager told us he was comping our meal. It took 1 hour 30 minutes for the steak to come out after the appetizers. The manager then still charged us for the drink though he told us it was comped. We got violently ill after the meal from food poisoning and were up all night vomiting. Please try another steakhouse in the city.
Great food and awesome atmosphere on University. The pulled pork tacos and buckets of beer make the blind pig the next big thing on Uni.

Best lunch in 2019. ... food,service, atmosphere
Was outstanding. A gem for sure. Love the fresh lemonade ( most restaurants don't have it).
Will return often for their other tasty, well prepared barbecue, & side dishes. Love those biscuits...buy a bag to go. Yummy

I have been meaning to try Freddy's ever since they opened and I'm glad I finally did! The food tasted great and the portions were pretty good too. I asked (and was charged) for a regular serving of cheese curds, but I felt like they were never ending! A mini concrete is also the perfect size for me. So many varieties that all sounded good.
Only mishap was that our number was called claiming that our order was ready, but then we ended up having to wait at the counter for a few solid minutes because it actually wasn't done.
As far as Covid protocols go, I saw staff wiping down the main doors, but all the tables were not cleaned which gave us a hard time when it came to finding a table. The place was busy! Not sure if they are limiting capacity at this time inside, but all the tables around us were full. Drive-thru is also an option.

I was in the area and trying to find something for my husband and I to eat. He said try to find tacos in the area. I was like here we go again, because we've been finding taco places as we're running errands and we've been striking; we have yet to get really good tacos. I found Michoacana Grill and took a look at the food photos and rating on Yelp, looked good to me. My husband has the steak tacos and I had the shrimp tacos. They well exceeded my expectations! The tacos are SO GOOD!! We sat in the car and ate our tacos and my husband raved and raved about how good his tacos were. So, he went back in and ordered 3 more tacos with guacamole to go. And yes, the guacamole is just as good as the tacos! You can just eat that all by itself. Sadly, we don't live close to Michoacana Grill, but I'll have to find something to do in the area to make a stop back in there again.

Our favorite casual spot nearby! Good food, great drinks. We love their mini Juicy Lucy's, buffalo quesadilla, and even the sushi is decent. They have good appetizers too, but their portions are definitely big enough that it's not always necessary! Their beer towers are a great price and they always have plenty of seasonal mixed drinks to choose from if you want to switch it up and try something new.
Good food and coffee! Nice little outdoor patio. Came here to work though so there wasn't enough space for that!
When tourists ask me where to get a really good steak sandwich in Old City, I always send them to Jim's.  It never disappoints.

I have been going here for 6 years now, and have never had a bad meal. Not sure who is giving this place less than 5 stars; this is quietly one of the best and most consistent restaurants in New Orleans. Truly authentic southern food done right.

Also an incredibly good bargain given the quality of the food and quality of service. 

Also did I mention they have an amazing bar?

Great menu interesting atmosphere and short staffed. There were several empty tables but you had to wait a half hour until people left I suppose it was due to to not enough wait staff. There must be an option to sit at the bar because there were several empty spots but we were told we had to wait. They encourage reservations which I also encourage so they don't have to wait near empty tables for staff. The food was great though.
Best place to eat in the usa. Possibly  the world.   Drinks are perfect.  Food is edible art.

Blaze Pizza is my favorite fast pizza place! I love the spicy red sauce Every ingredient is fresh, the place has a great vibe and the staff is awesome, Dillon walked around and made sure everyone was enjoying their food. My experience was great for my first time visiting this location!
This is one of my favorite restaurants in clearwater! Always good and professional service, as well as amazing food.

My go to brunch spot, the staff is very friendly and helpful. The atmosphere is lovely and more importantly, the food looks great and taste amazing. I like to order something savory and share something sweet with my daughter. Probably the best chai in the city.

The pizza was really good and the salad was big enough to share with two or three other people. All of the ingredients were fresh. They have wings, salads, full pizzas, and by the slice. Two slices and salad to share was more than enough. There's seating which is comfortable and a bar next door that connects inside. They have a deal with a slice of pizza and pint of beer for five dollars! Not the most extravagant restaurant in the city but a very good pizza place with great prices for a late night snack or if you're looking for something within budget!

I really enjoyed this place! My friend and I wanted to try something new nearby, and when I read "Jamaican-Korean fusion", I was all in. My friend and I came in on a Sunday around 6pm, the place wasn't crowded at all. There's a bar when you walk in, and more seating with tables in the back. We asked to be seated in the back, and the place is dimly lit, with a lit candle sitting on each table- I'm guessing it's a part of the ambience. Anyways, our server was really nice, and my friend and I both ended up ordering the pineapple bowl (I got the grilled shrimp one and she got the pulled jerk chicken). The pineapple bowl was pretty much a halved and carved pineapple (which was obviously the bowl), filled with fried rice, pineapple chunks, and your choice of protein. I really enjoyed the marriage of flavors between the fried rice and pineapple chunks and found myself scraping the sides of the pineapple just so I can get more flavor in with the rice. The rice was cooked well, as was the shrimp, and I must have been really hungry because I ended up devouring the whole bowl! I was hesitant on getting dessert afterwards, but I decided to treat myself because, why not? I got the Korean red bean plantain sundae and my friend got the Appleton rum chocolate sundae. I've never had red bean before, so the server was nice enough to let me try a sample of the ice cream before ordering, and the red bean flavor has a very distinguishable yet indescribable taste... basically it was good. And as a

Whenever I come back to Reno...this is a must stop. I've lost count of how many times I've been here and every time it is just as good as the last. My two favorites on the menu are the salmon Niçoise salad and the cinque terra sandwich! 

We obviously had to order curbside pickup..and this time we ordered the cinque terra sandwich, the sandwich of the week which I believe was a spicy chicken and bacon sandwich, and then the Italian salad. Super fresh and super delicious! This place does an amazing job of finding combinations that just works. Everything on the menu to to die for so you really cannot go wrong! 

Please support this amazing business. I promise you will be very thankful for stopping here! Can't wait to go back!

This. Is. Philly. Parks on tap symbolizes the start of summer and is one of my most anticipated openings each year. This year brings new locations including Historic Rittenhouse. Tonight was a gorgeous warm spring night. The food is average but that's not what you should go for--go for the beer (good local beer and decent food), go for the dogs, the atmosphere and the friendly vibes. Again, there's really no better way to put it than this is what Philly is all about. Parks on tap has a simplicity and relaxed vibe that other beer gardens just can't achieve and it highlights some incredible areas around the city that you may otherwise not venture to--do yourself a favor, check the schedule and go.

We used a groupon which ended up being a great deal. We did the cemetery tour and had a phenomenal guide, Luke. He did such a great job of presenting historical facts in a very entertaining manner. Our group appreciated the way in which he delivered the historical context. 

GREAT JOB LUKE!

Post-Covid, still a lovely experience! And they brought back the daily happy hour that includes pizza from 3-5 pm. Our service was absolutely wonderful- we squeezed in as many happy hour drinks as possible thanks to the attentiveness of our server. Meats and cheeses were great, and the pizzas never disappoint. Masks and social distancing was enforced. If you need the restroom, it is now restricted, so ask the hostess for a key.

Strip mall Mexican, let's go!  Chemical tasting margarita, full STOP!  It's COVID so waiting, extra curve on timing, understandable attitude.  Yes, yes, yes.  We do all these.  This was shocking.  Because it happened twice.  We ordered a pitcher of skinny margs, they tasted like lime Kool-Aid, retry regular margs.  They had a chemical cleaning taste, I only had one.  The service, speedy.  Food slayed all day.  Loved the freshness of the ingredients.  I want to try again, because I want to love this place.  Maybe it was an off night, even in nashvegas we have them.

Great vegetarian menu!! I don't eat meat and vPho has a wonderful selection of vegetarian items. My favorites are the veggie hoagie, the vegetable pho, and the tofu spring rolls. We've been getting takeout from here during COVID and I'm always satisfied with my order.
Very nice place like the kids play area especially as we don't have that in our area back home. Food and service was excellent!!!

So I have been here twice so far and I'm a fan. First time, we went the week it open but it wasn't too busy. This last time, we went during happy hour. They have a great happy hour. We ordered the frozen lillet and it was to die for! The girls next to us order one too because we raved about how good it was. We also ordered the whipped feta and I kid you not, I licked that plate clean. We sat out on the patio which was covered but it was very windy. There has been a distinct smell though outside and I can't put my finger on it. Hopefully it will go away because it was there the two times I've gone. Will be there frequently because I'm down the street. YAY

I love their gyro meat.

I've ordered UberEats from here three days in a row. The first time I got a Gyro Platter and dolmades. The Gyro Platter comes with your choice of potato salad or greek rice (go with the potato salad, the third time I switched to Greek rice to see if I was missing out and I found it just meh), pita bread, Greek salad and one dolmade. 

The second time I got the Gyro Platter and a kid's meal of chicken tenders and the third time I got a Gyro Platter with a side of extra Gyro meat. 

I've learned I'm addicted to their Gyro meat. The Platter comes with a huge helping of it and is a steal at about $12. The pita is soft and I'm always tempted to spend $.95 to get an extra serving (next time I'll do that, especially when getting extra gyro meat). The meat is a little fatty/greasy, but I think that's what makes it so delicious. It still tastes good cold if you refrigerate the leftovers and eat some for breakfast, like I did. Breakfast of champions. 

I thought the dolmades were tasty too, but once I learned I got one with my Gyro Platter, I recognized that one is enough for me. 

My son seemed to like the fries. He didn't touch the chicken, so my husband ate it and said it was ok. I'm not coming here for the kid's meal, I'm coming here for my gyro (well, getting it delivered, but you get the idea). 

They are always super fast getting it ready. Usually it's at my house within 30 minutes.

Tiny restaurant but very busy; indoor and outdoor seating.
Servers were hustling but they didn't seem pressured; there was a delay on food since kitchen extremely busy.
Pretty good for tapas but pricey.
Interesting take on beet salad; we thoroughly enjoyed the Kobe slider family pack and both steak and pork tacos.
Desserts ok - decadent chocolate cake, crepe brûlée and banana fosters.
I forgot to use the check in free dessert coupon on yelp.

Server Robert acknowledged us at door and sat us right away; he provided good service - he scores a 4.

We decided to check out Tasty and Delicious based on their reviews and it did not disappoint.  The restaurant is clean and neat, staff was friendly and helpful, service was quick, and the food was delicious.  We each got different hamburgers and each were delicious.  Food was simple but had great flavor.  We will be coming back again!
Burgers + sushi + beer = happy mama! And love that kids are welcome. Good food, good vibes.

According to my Chicagoan buddy, the pie did not closely enough resemble Chicagoan thin crust.  With that said, he didn't shy away from pounding slice after slice.  Toppings placed under the cheese opposed to ontop which was an unexpected, but not detrimental, wrinkle. Overall, good flavor and only moderately greasy.

My daughter & I visited Toast For the first time. We sat at the bar to eliminate the long wait for a table. I ordered the spinach mushroom crepe & my daughter built her own breakfast. My crepe was good but I wasn't a fan of the cheese as it was a bit too much & I didn't care for the texture. Next time I'll request mozzarella. My daughter loved the grits, bacon & toast but didn't like the ratatouille. I'm a pescatarian & love veggies but I didn't like the ratatouille either. It was very bland & unenjoyable. My cranberry mimosa was good. The service was great. The server was very attentive. The inside is very small with limited seating, which makes me unsure if I'll return given the amount of time it takes to get a table. But overall we enjoyed our first experience.
Great English style PUB dive bar. Honey BBQ wings are great. Good local beers. Lots of TV'S

Great spot ! It's so hard to find good donuts. Not Krispy kreme generic greasiness, but a good soft and fluffy donut. When that is your base, all of the fun, vibrant flavors and varieties golden dinosaurs comes up with are delightful. That coupled with good vegan eats so you can satisfy all your food cravings in one spot - what a gem. Thanks for existing guys!

Great ambiance, very attentive staff and amazing thai food. Absolutely loved their pad thai. Will definitely come back to dine here if I ever come to Philadelphia again. I highly recommend their special non-alcoholic drinks..
Very slow, half of my order was incorrect or not served to me, and the food was only sub par. Does not compare to other IHOP's I have gone to in the past.

Loved this spot! A little bit of a wait but definitely worth it. They were so very happy to assist me with my dietary needs, and the food was delicious. Margaritas packed a punch, definitely a spot I would go back to.

Walking in I was a little skeptical of the building but was happily surprised. The atmosphere inside was very modern and clean and had game board activities to entertain people of all ages. The staff was very friendly and helpful with ordering and answering any question about food or drinks. Prices vary on what you want to order and can be as cheap as $3 for a popping boba drink (small) or $5 for a regular size with boba and popping bubbles. I ordered a milky green tea regular size drink with boba and white peach yogurt popping bubbles and it was very good.

Wayside is a hidden gem and I'm so glad i discovered it. Their cheese steaks and breakfast is perfect, never been disappointed with anything from here and everyone I've introduced to wayside also loves it. I definitely recommend them
Best Benedicts ever!!  Love eating outside on the patio in good weather.  Favorite date place.  Great meal, great dessert - you can't go wrong here - there's something for everyone!

Came here from the reviews. This by far the absolute worst restaurant in this town. I order the steak sandwich and was practically thrown a thin slice of non seasoned meat on a price of bread. I asked the server for ASU and some condiments to put on. He took forever and by the time my condiments came, my sandwich was cold. Also the sides they offered were terrible. My green beans were soggy and seemed as if they came out of a can. I wouldn't even feed this food to my dog. It was awful. Stay clear of this nasty restaurant.

We always choose Ristorante Roma for special occasions and they never disappoint. The service is exceptionally pleasant, very good wine selections, and the food is the fabulous. Lucio, John, Alexia, and the rest of the team have taken care to make it a very safe environment, tables are more than adequately spaced and guests are treated as long-time acquaintances. This is our number one go-to selection for fine dining.

I've been to Dooney's several times and absolutely love it! The atmosphere is perfect no matter what you're looking for. I love the outdoor area, but there's really no bad seat in the place. The food is delicious! I've had their wings which were juicy and delicious as well as salads. Servers have always been attentive, friendly and professional!

One of my favorite restaurants in Nashville.. However, it didn't live up to the standards tonight. March Madness is going on so I was expecting a long wait time for our food. However, the wait for our food ended up being more than an hour for four entrees. After an hour, we asked our server for an update on where our food was. One entree showed up but the other 3 were still missing... 10 minutes go by, the other three entrees never showed up. Starting to get very frustrated, I asked to speak to a manager. Manager was busy in the kitchen and was not able to speak. Long story short, we waited an hour and only received 1/4 entrees. Our server said "your food was lost and dropped off at the wrong table in the cocktail section." Thank you for comping our two appetizers. We left frustrated and hungry- but good thing for Two Boots Pizza being right next door.

Carli was awesome and made my lady and I feel at home. Great Monday drank special and whiskey selection. Fish was amazing my favorite mashed potatoes. Definitely our new Monday spot we'll be back next week.

I recently stumbled upon jems after a coworker recommended it. I got a breakfast sandwich, a hoagie, and a cheesesteak. Everything was absolutely amazing. While in the store I got to chat with the owner, Mike, who was a great guy. Then coincidentally later that night I was at the polish club in Clifton for Clifton pool's fundraiser. There food at the benefit was awesome, especially the mac and cheese. Jems is a great store that seems like its ran by a good guy and they will have my business as long as im in the area
The pizza is mediocre, they rarely get your topping selection right, and the management team is extremely rude. I would suggest ordering elsewhere, it's not worth the price at all.

Just three of us, here for the first time. Pretty great experience. Delicious food. Not overcooked, not too salty, not too dry. The only downside was they told us they closed at 6 (we got there at 530 and had already ordered and was sis aged and in the middle of eating what we had ordered). We noticed them locking the doors, so we asked and they told us they closed at 6. We left at 615. Came back at 8:00 to pick up a vehicle we had left there and noticed people going in, ordering, sitting down to eat. This was on a Wednesday night a week or two ago. Can't imagine why they'd tell us 6pm when they're still letting people order and dine in around 8pm. Seems suspicious to me, but that was the only downside.

The food here and the service is the best I've ever had. The food was so tasteful and fresh. The owner Gio was the best in his hospitality and kindness. All the ingredients were fresh as if it was picked right outback in his own personal garden. They treat you like family and like you have been know forever. Best place in Ybor.

If you're debating trying Little Susie's, PLS GO! As soon as I called, the employee on the other end was extremely friendly, helpful, & accommodating. Upon arriving (let i note this place is adorable) our order was ready to go. More pleasant encounters with staff. Iced coffee was phenomenal, as was the americano. Probably top 3 coffees I've ever had. The pork roll pie had me savoring every bite! I will be back tomorrow to say the least!

I had the platter, one meat and two sides. Taste pretty good, price is fawould come back again

Updated review on 6/4/19:
I liked this place so much that I've been back a few times after my first review. The taste of the food have been met my satisfaction but not the quantity! The amount of food got smaller and i am still hungry after the meal. A little bit disappointed.

Ordered to go for weekend dinner.  Biryani and Samosas!!  Initially when opened, it was basically white rice with little of fried onion. At first I was little surprised and disappointed since I didn't see any chicken.  But I was wrong!!  Nice surprise! A lot of curry gravy and chicken were underneath the bed of rice.  My daughter who really into the Indian food says the food from this place is one of the best so far she has ever eaten.  Definitely will back to try other stuff.

This is easily the best Indian Buffet I've been to so far in Indianapolis, and I've been jumping around trying to find something impressive. Tandoori Flame does not disappoint. Not only are there plenty of options for meat eaters and vegetarians, they even had a few dishes I've never tried like the Chicken Majestic. Often when I go to buffets I find the recipes are watered down and lacking in spice (I imagine it's a strategy to reach a wider palette and please more folks) but here I was pleased to find each dish was generously spiced and a few even had a great kick to them. The service was wonderful and everyone was friendly as well as prompt. The rice was excellent, the fresh naan kept coming in a quick pace, and they filled our waters rapidly which was super needed. I can't wait to go back to this delightful place.

Sandwiches and Craft Beer together makes WichCraft! Albeit not the kind of potions or brooms but certainly with a hint of its own magic no doubt.

Cubaneo, sandwiched in between The Broken Shaker and Modern Times, is a small order and sit restaurant providing authentic and quality Cuban foods for everyone to enjoy. Puns aside, the sandwiches are amazing. I love ordering a Cubano sandwich to pair with the lazy weekend brews from Modern Times next door. 

If you've never had a Cuban dish. Wait no more and visit Cubaneo to try yourself.

The food is pretty tasty, but I always get mild food poisoning after eating here. ALWAYS. First time I thought it was a fluke, second time I blamed the sushi I had earlier, but by the 3rd time? This place cooks with something that always makes me bound to sit on the toilet in 2-3 hours. Always.

It was a small place. I'm sure if it wasn't winter that less people would be waiting because the patio would be open. We were told about a 25 minute wait and waited a little longer than that. We were prepared to wait, so it wasn't a big deal. It was a Saturday during breakfast/brunch time. I've worked in food service and know that it is difficult to estimate wait time.
My group went for brunch. I ordered the Florentine omelette with the potatoes, wheat toast, and iced tea. I was surprised at how great it was. The hollandaise sauce on top of the omelette was the perfect amount. I tried a bite of my friend's biscuits and gravy and it was also delicious. The food was definitely worth the wait.
It was definitely loud inside, but again it was busy. It wasn't so loud that you couldn't hear the people were sitting with. Our server was friendly and attentive. They also had someone in addition to the server going around and filling up the water for everyone, which was nice because my group drinks a lot of water.
The mimosas looked good. The table next to us was enjoying them. Next time, my group will have to get them as well.

Love this place, amazing food! I especially love the pad see ew and pineapple fried rice. Whole family is in love with the yellow curry and Thai iced tea. The portions are generous and good for sharing. Very friendly staff and quick service. We're  pretty bummed we're not local, but will definitely come back next time we're in Santa Barbara.

Very delicious tartes, buttery crust  and smooth custard fillings with fresh fruit on top. You can have in bite size or  full size. The chocolate covered  brûlée is so smooth and not overly sweet Canele is ok. It's missing the citrusy taste.

Who doesn't like a party and music while drinking mimosas? I hosted a brunch for my meetup group here. It was 18 of us total. Our waitress was amazing. I wish I remembered her name ‍‍. The Ainsworth offers a bottle of champagne and a craft of orange juice for $18 dollars. I'll say it again $18 dollars!! It was love at first sight for me. I enjoyed the music and the vibes. The food was mediocre, but when you can buy a bottle of champagne for $18 dollars, who cares about the food. I'll be back for brunch and more champagne!!!

Amazing salmon on a bed of spaghetti squash and spinach. The shrimp cocktail was another story. Freeze it, defrost it then pre wrap it in a fridge. Taste fake, was fake and disappointing for the price you pay at Bascom. Will return but stay away from appetizers.
Not sure if they are open for take out during the state "shelter in place" order. Called on a Wednesday night at 7 for take out and got an answering machine with default message.

We chose this restaurant for the reviews and they open 24 hours on Fridays and Saturdays per their website and hours listed on Yelp.  We arrived at 0450 15 June 2019 to a dark, closed restaurant with an empty parking lot.  There weren't even employee cars there for workers preparing to open the restaurant.

I've been dying to try Emmy Squared for quite some time now. However, with the explosion of amazing pizza locations in Philly, and particularly South Philly area... I just can't get to them all quickly enough! 

Late evening on a Friday night, my friend and I were hungry and craving pizza. We had called all the popular pizza joints we hadn't tried within a reasonable walking distance, but all were SOLD OUT! The horror! We decided to check out Emmy Squared, even though it would require us to potentially lose our parking spot-- the struggles of inner city living, amirite? LOL. 

Alas! Emmy Squared was taking orders, and we quickly placed our order through the Yelp app and made our way over there. There was quite a long pick-up line when I got there, and plenty of orders ready to go. Seeing the popularity and shear volume of orders, made me even more excited for the food! 

Pick-up was streamlined and quick. They have a cube-shelf in their vestibule, where they place completed To-Go orders with names and app ordered on (e.g. GH Ajia stood for GrubHub Ajia), so you can just grab-n-go if it's ready! There is staff nearby if you have any questions and monitoring the pick-up area, as necessary. All safety cautions of social distancing, masks, gloves, and hand sanitizers are in place and also available. 

DELUXE RED PIZZA:
This square, pan pizza had a perfectly crispy, caramelized crust (edges?). The sauce was nice and thick. Toppings were plentiful. I think the pizza was good, but n

Toscano's specialty steak sandwich for lunch was a big hit with me and my daughter loved hers too. I was pleasantly surprised that it came with three spears of asparagus that were done just right. The signature plate was a tempting introduction to the Toscano steakhouse's offerings, and gave me a taste of what to come back for. I'd love to try this place again when passing through Bordentown. Draft beers were limited but adequate: a Sam Adams, a seasonal pumpkin ale, and Peroni.

Amazing! The family got the typical tiki masala, vegetable korma, and butter chicken - all great! My salmon wrapped in a banana leaf was out of this world!! Robert was our server and he was attentive and helpful when suggesting a different meal for me. My new favorite Indian restaurant.

This is by far my favorite Mexican spot in the city. I moved here from Texas which is notorious for it's Tex Mex cuisine and this place reminded me of home. Staff is super friendly and kitchen is generous with the portion sizes! 100% recommend if you are in the mood for some in expensive good Mexican food!
Sweet tea! Atmosphere...location. Music. All great. Wasn't impressed with the food, but I imagine the BBQ is on point.
Delicious - every time. Wait staff is great. Order taker has a pleasant smile and a sense of humor.

I have been to the Garden Table location downtown several times, but never to broad ripple, and I'd have to say I like this location a little better. It's set up more like a coffee shop and you order your food at the counter and then have a seat until your food is brought out. It's a seat yourself location and small enough to be cozy. Waiters ensure your comfort and needs are meet by taking a community approach to serving customers. We had nearly 4 different people check on us while waiting and eating. 

The food itself is very delicious and there are a surprising amount of diet friendly options. I branched our and tried the hash with apples, sweet potato, bacon, brussel sprouts and eggs. To my surprise it was AMAZING and potentially the best brunch food I've ever had. I did add a little salt since overall it was fairly sweet. We stuck with water to drink but there are fresh pressed juices, coffee, and teas. There are some specials listed but typically all items are on the menu! Enjoy!

First and most importantly, the food is average, but the price is above average. The food quality does not equal the cost. I had a taco salad which would have been better with taco meat instead of chili. My wife had the shrimp plate with what seemed to be old noodles. The tea was stale. The service was good and the manager was nice, but that does not justify me ever coming back to this restaurant.
Amazing and quick place to grab a bite to eat! Was craving seafood when I went at ordered the scallops and shrimp pasta it was amazing, light, and simple! The staff was very friendly as well

We ordered from Makay Thai for the first time. Good arrived in a timely manner and good portion sizes. Four meals in total and they were all delicious. I ordered the Pad Thai which was one of the best I have eaten.  It was fresh, flavorful and with good size pieces of chicken. My husband ate the chicken fried rice and likewise, had only complements. I highly recommend this restaurant when you are in the mood for Chinese or Thai cuisine.

I've been in the area for about 2.5 years and am constantly searching for a great salad bar in Tampa ! Back in North Carolina , I was a frequent visitor of Chopt Creative Salad Company and they are the bar extremely high ! Out of all the places that I've tried in Tampa , this place is by far better then them all however , there can be some improvements ! 

Just a few things i noticed :

Typically , I prefer kale as my base but the kale at the location was discolored . It appeared to be turning yellow at the tips so I opted for the mix. Lastly , the salad dressing was extremely watery and seemed to weigh down the salad . Definitely not freshly made.

I would def try this place again with the hopes that over time some things will improve!

My husband and I recently went to your restaurant. It was beyond amazing. I recommend it to the universe! Michael , the manager on duty was so very kind and helpful. Our waitstaff Isaiah and Christian made the evening magical. We will recommend this restaurant forever and ever!And we will be back many many times. The food and the ambience is meant for royalty and they allowed us to be a part of that, thank you again!!!!!

Went on the Ghosts and Vampires tour last night with Bobby Thomas.  He was a great story teller (funny, too!) and the history and stories were very interesting.  I found the long walk of the tour kind of a neat, relaxing thing to do in the midst of all the NOLA chaos.  In addition, we did the garden district and Lafayette cemetery tour with Ducky.  Ducky was such an awesome guide and was HILARIOUS.  I would recommend both tours (and this company) without hesitation!!

Take out only. No outdoor seating. They installed a plastic wall between the cashier and you. Quick 10 min drive away from downtown. Highly recommend getting the #1S and #4. I like how each noodle dish is accompanied by specific sauces and the protein really differentiates it from other restaurants. Must try the noodles! I tried the bahn mi as well. Though impressed by the soft baguette, not impress by the pork.
Hi, I was having a ruff day and I asked for extra Caesar sauce and croutons. You all pulled thru and it really made my day :) thank you
Great tasing empanadas, sometimes a little on the burnt side. We've ordered over the phone and in person, and the staff was equally unfriendly. Good food, bad service.

Love this hot chicken. I've tried Prince's, which is also great, but I appreciate the opportunity to call and order ahead for curbside pickup. The  portions are huge so you'll have leftovers, and the chicken is just as good the second day. Every time we come to Nashville, we eat here.

Went on a Friday night and it was crowded but well stocked. The staff was rude an inattentive. It took some time before anyone took our drink order. The selection was satisfying- mostly seafood dishes & Chinese food with other normal offerings, ribs, Mac & cheese, fried chicken...but nothing especially stood out. The desserts were terrible. It wasn't horrible, but for the price I probably won't return.

This place was amazing! There was something for everyone at our table. The meats were all cooked perfectly (some were a little too salty for my taste but everyone else enjoyed them so that was just a matter of preference). There were so many choices of beef, chicken,lamb, and shrimp and they kept it coming. 

The hot/cold choices on the buffet table were delicious and plentiful as well. 
I especially enjoyed the Brazilian rice, the black beans, shrimp, cheeses, asparagus and green beans. The Brazilian bread that they serve at your table and the fried polenta are really good as well. 

We ordered a pitcher of Sangria (red), a piña colada and another drink (I cannot remember the name) -they were all great.

The service was excellent. Everyone was very friendly and attentive. 

Unfortunately, we did not have room for dessert and had a birthday cake waiting for us at home so we did not try any of the desserts. Maybe next time!
Love the BBQ chicken and ribs.  Take out is great, not a place for ambience, just for BBQ delicious meats.

This is our first time at this restaurant. The food was tasty.We ordered one of the family dinners. There was plenty of food. It is more traditional Chinese vs some of the restaurants out there are Asian fusion. The service was excellent. The dining room was very nice with white table cloths.
great local breakfast shop, best pancakes in town and hunter's sausage is amazing!  Super friendly owner/operator, glad to have them back :)

I've gotten takeout a few times in the past few months. Until today, I would have recommended Yantze. But today I tried something new (new for me), the Chicken Lettuce Wrap. What I got was a plastic container of chicken and a box of lettuce. The chicken seemed like chopped leftovers; but dining in is closed, so it can't be, right? What gets Yantze 1 star and guarantees I won't return is the box of spoiled lettuce. I can imagine that they pre-cut the lettuce, boxed it, and maybe put it in the refrigerator - a few days ago - and then gave it to me without looking at it (as opposed to cutting spoiled lettuce and knowingly giving it to me), but I have to wonder now how much of the ingredients they use are spoiled.

Are you considering eating here? Do it! I've been here 3 times. Every time has been amazing. The food is incredible. Seriously. Delicious. 
Like ohmygod. I don't even have the words. Seriously, just eat here.

I have only ever ordered take-out from this location, but it is consistently delicious. People may say it's "catering to Western palates" and blah blah, but bottom line, it hits the spot every single time. My go-to order is the Shrimp Tikka Masala with Peshawari naan with almond, coconut, pistachio, and cashew. The prices are steep, I will admit that, but I can usually eat one entree over two meals. The wait times can be long as hell, but the staff are friendly and apologetic. They're definitely doing the best they can with the amount of orders they have coming through. Great for a quick Indian fix, I'll be back time and time again!

Stopped in on the last day of vacation while in Nashville. Been disapointed with most food offerings... but when the dry rub ribs came out, paired with the mac n cheese and green beans... . I am in Hog Heaven.  My wife thouroughly enjoyed her Catfish, potato casserole and greens. We will be back next time we are in town! Alexis really knew how to provide great service... and kept up on my ice tea.... which is NO EASY TASK...

I had the gnocchi special which was very doughy. My husband had a pasta dish and the portion was very small. I had a mushroom and goat cheese "flatbread" type dish which was very bland. The service was friendly and excellent.

Hole in the wall from the outside, food paradise on the inside. Cheerful authentic Mexican food. Soccer  in Spanish is usually playing on a small tv in the corner. Very bright and colorful interior. Solid food. Affordable. Definitely worth trying this place out.
The Yellow Porch is open for takeout business!  The owner Katie is adding family size meals to the menu.  Put this on your list for your safe get out of the house social distancing excursions!

Okay happy hour oysters. Okay apps. But weak drinks. Like, watered down tasting. It felt like a ripoff. It's pretty ironic given that the name is Tipsy's. Not only do the drinks taste worse than usual, but they also.... didn't make me tipsy or even buzzed.

Talk about "I'm Hooked", I'm hooked on this place! Wow, who knew this bagel place would change my mind about bagels (I was never a fan of bagels and they seemed so boring to me). It was my first time going this morning before heading out for work and Truckee Bagel did a good job of making my morning!

I don't remember what my husband got (shown on the left) but I ordered a hot I'm Hooked Sandwich and it was so bomb! The bagel was toasted well to where it wasn't burnt. I'm a savory person so the cheese and barbecue sauce went well together. I believe the meat I chose was turkey. Also, if you're a cream cheese person, I highly recommend to grab chives when choosing the savory bagel flavor. From now on I'm grabbing my quick breakfast here!

I'm staying at a hotel right around the corner from Wasabi, so I decided to stop in for dinner on Tuesday night. When I walked in at 5:45, I was told it was going to be a 30 minute wait for one. I decided to go someplace else.

Wednesday night I tried Wasabi again, this time I walked in at 7:30 and was seated right away. I sat at the table for 10 minutes and asked the host to send over a waitress before I was even acknowledged. Once my waitress came to the table, she was nice. I ordered a drink and my dinner, a tempura Cali roll and side of fried rice. The tempura Cali roll came out hot and fresh, but the friend rice didn't come out until I was done with my roll. I ate a few bites of it, but it had so much scrambled egg in it, I didn't taste very good. I'm not a big fan of the texture of eggs and this fried rice had egg in every bite.

I would go back for the sushi or order take out, but the service wasn't amazing.
Ordered my first hurricane there. First food shop in New Orleans. Ordered the Taste of New Orleans and their famous Oysters. The oysters were delicious!!!!
I had a horrible experience yesterday! I went to this tgi on my lunch break.  One of the employees wasn't sure at all on the food that you had! I'll never go back !! Highly disappointed!
I visit from Massachusetts to Clearwater a few times a year to visit family. Always stop here a couple times per visit. Steak and cheese is as good as you will find anywhere. LOVE IT
A lot of good vegetarian options, the BEST tofu I've ever had.  usually not a long wait either
Our server Mando gave us excellent service. The food was delicious and perfect for my midnight cravings!

Arario is my favorite place in Midtown! When we go in we are always greeted warmly by the owner and treated like family. Everything on the menu is great, so I suggest bringing in a large group of friends so you can get most things on the menu and share. Its way too difficult to pick just one favorite dish, but if I had to it would be the kimchee fries. They're insanely delicious and truly unique. The burger is one of the best in town which you would never expect. I look forward to being able to go in and enjoy the atmosphere again when we all can, but I am thankful they are doing takeout so we can get our biweekly fix.

Daisy Mae's was on my must try list for years and ironically I finally made it in for a takeout order during  the Covid lock down. You can smell the grill from a mile away! We ordered the 14 oz ribeye dinner. It is served with a baked potato, side salad, pinto beans  and garlic butter toast. My husband and I split the meal and it was actually the perfect amount of food! The highlights were actually all the sides. The ribeye unfortunately was very tough. But the pinto beans were delicious! Smokey and bacony with a hint of spice. Perfectly seasoned. The baked potato was served with all the fixings-  butter, green onion and sour cream. The salad greens were nice and fresh and we indulged in ranch dressing. The food is simple. I can't remember the last time I ate white toast with garlic butter. It was all worth it. Just wish the steak was better quality. It really was tough. But... I'll definitely come back for the full experience in the dining room. Calling in the order was super easy and ready with in 20 minutes.
